Label: oviparous
Definition: A reproductive quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce offspring that develop inside a shelled egg, with a large food supply in yolk, after internal fertilization.
Editor note: Existing term; included here as reference example.

Label: viviparous
Definition: A reproductive quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce offspring that are born live, or where the development of the offspring is supported by either parent in or on any part of their body.
Editor note: Existing term; included here as reference example.

Label: ovoviviparous
Definition: A reproductive quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce offspring that are born live after retaining the eggs inside the body of the female.
Editor note: Existing term; included here as reference example.

Label: ovuliparous
Definition: A reproductive quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce offspring via external fertilization, the oocytes being released and fertilized outside the female's body by the male.
Editor note: Existing term; included here as reference example.
